title: Lesson 1 Quiz: Reading Price Charts with Confidence

questions.text: What characterises a market uptrend on a stock chart?
options: A series of higher highs and higher lows
A series of lower highs and lower lows
Prices remaining strictly within a horizontal range
Fluctuations driven entirely by balance sheet earnings
questions.explanation: An uptrend occurs when price movements form a series of higher highs and higher lows.

questions.text: True or false: A technical resistance level can transform into a new support level after the price breaks above it.
questions.explanation: When price breaks through a previous resistance ceiling, that price level frequently becomes a new support floor.
